盘前结论

油价与芯片抛售压制风险偏好，稳汇率、要约收购与港股业绩提供事件线索

A/H风险偏好偏弱：前一交易日A股与港股成长板块明显回落，隔夜油价飙升且美股芯片继续下跌。央行稳汇率、集成电路税惠申报、建研院要约、奕斯伟首挂与迅销业绩提供结构性线索，但全部需要今日正式价格确认。

重大新闻与事件

11
汇率政策
央行明确坚持有管理浮动汇率制度，不以竞争性贬值获取贸易优势；在美元与长债高位环境下，稳定预期有利于压低外资风险溢价。 source
健康与康复
国务院批复《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030年）》，医疗康复、辅助器具与科技助残链条获得中期政策锚。 source
集成电路税惠
北京启动2026年度集成电路企业增值税加计抵减清单申报，10月16日前网上提交；政策利好属于成本端支持，不等同于个股订单。 source
香港创科
香港创科及工业局提出前沿科技专组、航天科技项目征集、产学研和大湾区协同，利好方向仍需项目与预算落地验证。 source
港股信披
港交所与监管机构强化持续经营疑虑处理；无审计意见且未解决疑虑的业绩可能触发停牌，壳股与高杠杆公司折价风险上升。 source
AI产业
CNNIC报告称生成式AI继续赋能工业与服务业，预计2026年人形机器人整机产量突破10万台；主题景气与高估值需分开。 source
建研院
瀚启投资拟以5.03元/股要约收购9.90%，公司10月9日复牌；要约本身不直接构成控制权变更，后续协议转让和董事会改组仍有不确定性。 source
奕斯伟计算
01256.HK定价1.55港元并于今日挂牌；暗盘报价约1.54—1.575港元，分歧小但尚不能替代正式交易确认。 source
迅销
优衣库母公司FY2026经营利润同比增32%至7431.3亿日元、超预期，香港预托证券复牌后的价格反馈才是可交易确认。 source
李子园
独立董事兼审计委员会主任委员接受纪律审查；公司称与经营无关，但上半年归母净利同比降32.34%，治理与盈利信号同时偏弱。 source
五矿资源
MMG就巴西镍资产交易反垄断审查质疑欧盟取证，交易可能让步或受阻；关键矿产并购逻辑仍受监管约束。 source

隔夜美股交易总结

指数与广度
道指+0.1%，标普500-0.47%，纳指-1.25%；标普成份股约66%上涨，指数下跌主要由大型科技拖累。
行业与个股
费城半导体指数跌3.4%，NVDA约跌2.9%、AVGO跌4.4%、ORCL跌5.5%；医疗相对强，PEP业绩后涨3.7%。
利率与商品
30年债标售需求良好后10年收益率回落至约5.23%；Brent结算104.28美元、涨4.1%，仍是A/H最大宏观压力。

重点个股关注

建研院
A.603183
条件关注
事件：瀚启投资拟以5.03元/股收购9.90%，10月9日复牌；后续仍需协议转让、治理安排与审批配合。
最新反馈：停牌期间无可交易报价；5.03元较公告前30日加权均价4.83元约溢价4%，开盘价尚未知。
确认/失效：复牌后若价格不过度高于要约价且量价稳定，可继续观察；高溢价冲高回落、条款延期或控制权安排失败则失效。
奕斯伟计算
H.01256
条件关注
事件：RISC-V芯片公司今日首挂，发行价1.55港元；招股书与上市安排已核验。
最新反馈：正式市场尚未开盘；10月8日暗盘不同平台约1.54—1.575港元，仅作最近可得参考，不是当前成交。
确认/失效：开盘后守住1.55且成交承接、并强于恒科/芯片同业才确认；持续跌破1.48招股区间下限则失效。
迅销
H.06288
条件关注
事件：FY2026经营利润同比增32%至7431.3亿日元，连续第五年创纪录，并指引下一财年继续增长。
最新反馈：香港预托证券10月8日停牌；公司行情页最近可核验为10月5日36.40港元，复牌前无同步报价。
确认/失效：仅在复牌后价格守住最近参考位且量价确认时升级；若业绩利好兑现后跌破36.40或中国业务指引恶化则失效。
李子园
A.605337
回避
事件：独立董事兼审计委员会主任委员接受纪律审查，公司称案件与经营无关并将补选。
基本面反证：2026年上半年营收同比降2.69%、归母净利降32.34%，经营现金流净额同比降82.84%。
回避依据：提交前未取得可靠同步报价；治理空缺与盈利下滑尚未出现可核验反转，不因调查“与公司无关”的声明包装为多头。

板块轮动看板

汇率与高股息央行稳汇率表态有利于降低外资风险溢价，但长债和油价高位仍压制估值扩张。
半导体/RISC-V产业政策与奕斯伟上市提供事件流；SOX-3.4%、科创50盘中-4.47%构成明确价格反证。
能源与炼化Brent 104.28美元、单日+4.1%，上游受益而航空、化工下游和消费物流成本承压。
医药康复残疾预防计划与隔夜医药相对强势形成政策+外盘映射，仍需A股开盘广度确认。

逻辑链

央行稳汇率表态 → 贬值预期尾部风险下降 → 高股息与外资偏好资产先受益，但不抵消高利率压力。
Brent +4.1%至104.28美元 → 输入性通胀与成本压力升高 → 上游能源强、航空化工下游弱的分化扩大。
SOX -3.4%且纳指-1.25% → A/H高估值芯片承压 → 奕斯伟只作首日条件观察，不把题材直接转成买点。
要约与强业绩公告 → 建研院、迅销出现独立事件催化 → 必须等待复牌价格与成交确认，避免利好兑现。

风险雷达

隔夜科技纳指跌1.25%、SOX跌3.4%，A/H芯片若高开缺乏成交承接，反身性回撤风险高。
油债组合Brent 104.28美元、10年美债约5.23%，同时抬高成本与贴现率。
事件溢价建研院复牌、奕斯伟首挂、迅销复牌均可能一次性计价，追高不等于事件研究。
数据时效AKShare为10月8日盘中而非收盘；美股排行快照早于10月8日现金时段，按规则降级为0行。

数据来源与时间点

研究窗口截至2026-10-09 08:39 CST。AKShare schemaVersion=2、fetchedAt=2026-10-08 14:06 CST：A股marketDate=2026-10-08、marketPhase=intraday_snapshot，5491只样本上涨1622/下跌3724/平135，中位数-0.976%；港股2815只样本上涨614/下跌1142/平1054，中位数0%，均非收盘数据。美股排行快照fetchedAt=2026-10-08 10:15 CST，早于10月8日美股现金时段，行业与概念均降级为0行。建研院、奕斯伟、迅销和李子园报价均做过最新可得尝试，停牌/未开盘/同步报价不可得之处已逐项披露。主要事实源：央行/新华社、国务院、北京经信局、香港创科及工业局、HKEX/公司信披、Reuters、上海证券报。

Premarket Takeaway

Oil and chip selling weigh on risk appetite; RMB guidance, a tender and Hong Kong earnings offer event-driven offsets

A/H risk appetite is soft: growth shares fell in the prior A/H session, oil surged overnight and US chips sold off. PBOC currency guidance, IC tax support, Suzhou Institute’s tender, ESWIN’s debut and Fast Retailing’s results provide selective events, all requiring official-session price confirmation.

Major News and Events

11
FX policy
The PBOC reiterated a managed floating RMB regime and rejected competitive devaluation. Stable expectations can reduce the foreign-risk premium while the dollar and long yields stay elevated. source
Health and rehabilitation
The State Council approved the 2026–2030 disability-prevention action plan, giving a medium-term policy anchor to rehabilitation, assistive devices and health technology. source
IC tax support
Beijing opened 2026 applications for the integrated-circuit VAT super-deduction list, with online submissions due Oct 16. This is cost support, not evidence of company orders. source
Hong Kong innovation
Hong Kong’s ITIB outlined a frontier-technology task force, space-tech calls, university-industry programs and Greater Bay Area cooperation; budgets and projects still need confirmation. source
HKEX disclosure
HKEX and regulators tightened treatment of going-concern doubts; unresolved cases without an audit opinion may face suspension, raising the discount for leveraged and shell-like issuers. source
AI industry
A CNNIC report says generative AI is deepening industrial adoption and estimates 2026 humanoid-robot output above 100,000 units; theme momentum and valuation remain separate questions. source
Suzhou Institute
Jiangsu Hanqi proposes a partial tender for 9.90% at RMB5.03 and trading resumes Oct 9. The tender alone does not change control; later transfers and board changes remain uncertain. source
ESWIN Computing
01256.HK priced at HK$1.55 and lists today. Grey-market indications of HK$1.54–1.575 show modest divergence but do not replace official-session confirmation. source
Fast Retailing
FY2026 operating profit rose 32% to JPY743.13bn and beat expectations; the Hong Kong DR’s resumption price is still the tradable confirmation. source
Liziyuan
An independent director who chairs the audit committee is under investigation. The company says the case is unrelated to operations, but 1H attributable profit also fell 32.34%. source
MMG
MMG challenged the EU’s evidence in the Brazilian nickel antitrust review; concessions or blockage remain possible, keeping critical-minerals M&A exposed to regulation. source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Indexes and breadth
Dow +0.1%, S&P 500 -0.47%, Nasdaq -1.25%; about 66% of S&P constituents rose, with mega-cap technology driving the index decline.
Sectors and stocks
Philadelphia semis fell 3.4%; NVDA about -2.9%, AVGO -4.4% and ORCL -5.5%. Healthcare was relatively firm and PEP rose 3.7% after results.
Rates and commodities
Strong 30-year auction demand pulled the 10-year yield back near 5.23%; Brent settled at $104.28, +4.1%, the main macro pressure for A/H.

Stock Focus

Suzhou Institute of Building Science
A.603183
Conditional watch
Event: Jiangsu Hanqi proposes a 9.90% tender at RMB5.03 and trading resumes Oct 9; later transfers, governance changes and approvals are still required.
Latest feedback: no tradable quote was available during the halt. RMB5.03 is about 4% above the prior 30-day weighted-average price of RMB4.83; the opening price is unknown.
Confirm/invalidate: keep on watch only if resumption does not gap far above the tender price and turnover stabilizes; a high-premium reversal, delay or failed control plan invalidates it.
ESWIN Computing
H.01256
Conditional watch
Event: the RISC-V chip designer lists today at HK$1.55; the prospectus and listing schedule are verified.
Latest feedback: the official session has not opened. Oct 8 grey-market indications ranged from HK$1.54 to HK$1.575 and are only the latest available reference.
Confirm/invalidate: hold HK$1.55 with real-session support and outperform HSTECH/chip peers; sustained trade below the HK$1.48 offer-range floor invalidates.
Fast Retailing
H.06288
Conditional watch
Event: FY2026 operating profit rose 32% to JPY743.13bn, a fifth straight record, with further growth guided.
Latest feedback: the Hong Kong DR was halted Oct 8; the company quote page’s latest verifiable price is HK$36.40 on Oct 5, so no synchronized resumption quote exists yet.
Confirm/invalidate: upgrade only if the resumed price holds the latest reference with volume; a post-results break below HK$36.40 or weaker China guidance invalidates.
Liziyuan
A.605337
Avoid
Event: an independent director and audit-committee chair is under investigation; the company says the case is unrelated to operations and will appoint a replacement.
Fundamental counter-evidence: 1H revenue fell 2.69%, attributable profit 32.34%, and operating cash flow 82.84% year on year.
Avoid rationale: no reliable synchronized quote was obtained before submission; the governance vacancy and earnings decline lack a verified reversal and are not repackaged as bullish.

Sector Rotation

FX and dividendsPBOC currency guidance reduces foreign-risk premium, but high long yields and oil still cap multiple expansion.
Semis / RISC-VPolicy and ESWIN’s listing add events; SOX -3.4% and the STAR 50 -4.47% snapshot are clear price counter-evidence.
Energy and refiningBrent at $104.28, up 4.1%, favors upstream exposure while airlines, chemicals and logistics face cost pressure.
Healthcare and rehabThe disability-prevention plan plus US healthcare resilience create a policy/overnight mapping; A-share opening breadth must confirm.

Logic Chain

PBOC FX guidance → lower devaluation-tail risk → dividend and foreign-preference assets benefit first, without cancelling the high-rate drag.
Brent +4.1% to $104.28 → higher imported inflation and costs → wider divergence between upstream energy and airlines/chemical users.
SOX -3.4% and Nasdaq -1.25% → pressure on high-valuation A/H chips → ESWIN remains a first-day conditional watch, not an automatic buy.
Tender and earnings events → independent catalysts for Suzhou Institute and Fast Retailing → resumption price and volume must confirm.

Risk Radar

Overnight techNasdaq -1.25% and SOX -3.4%; A/H chips that gap up without volume support face reflexive drawdown risk.
Oil and yieldsBrent at $104.28 and the US 10-year near 5.23% lift both costs and discount rates.
Event premiumsSuzhou Institute’s resumption, ESWIN’s debut and Fast Retailing’s resumption may price news immediately; chasing is not research.
Data freshnessAKShare is an Oct 8 intraday snapshot, not the close; US rankings predate the Oct 8 cash session and are degraded to zero rows.
